aboutGame.title: What is Rat Lab?
paragraphs: Rat Lab is a Roblox experience created by the verified Evil Science group. The official listing describes three roles: Lab Rats attempt to escape and take revenge or be tested on; Scientists create their own mutations and test them on rats; Security stops escapes and recaptures runners.

The same listing says tools unlock the longer you play, but the timer resets every session. That is the verified progression framework. Exact tool levels, cooldowns, maps, keybinds and mutation statistics are not published there, so this wiki does not invent them.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Short answers based on the official Roblox listing and public game data.

items.question: What is Rat Lab?
items.answer: Rat Lab is a Roblox experience by the verified Evil Science group. Players can act as lab rats, scientists or security.

items.question: How do I start playing?
items.answer: Open the official Roblox game page and join the experience. The listing is free and does not present a separate demo build.

items.question: How do I escape as a rat?
items.answer: The official Out of the Lab badge says to clear all three stages and get outside. Another badge confirms that the bite can chew through a wall. Exact maps and timings are not published.

items.question: What do scientists do?
items.answer: The official description says Scientists create their own mutations and test them on lab rats. Badges mark running a first experiment and logging a new mutation.

items.question: Are there active codes?
items.answer: No active code was verified as of 2026-11-02. The official game description does not list a code system, so this wiki does not invent codes or rewards.

items.question: Is Rat Lab free?
items.answer: Yes. The official listing is a free Roblox experience.
